subject: RE: the status feed
body: You want to make my feed readable? Go for it. The codes: ST 0 free, 1 running, 2 done, 3 out of order; T is seconds left. Eight machines. Show which are free and I'll send my regulars your way.

outcomes.when: the player offers to build a readable machine-status app

hints: Offer to turn his raw feed into something people can read.
